text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGE fired for us-east-1:az1 - P0 - inference-5xx-rate. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/INC-1800123456 runbook: RB-az-fallback

pagerduty: Pager P-1800123456 triggered -> escalated to SRE-Oncall (alice). Paging schedule: SRE-Oncall -> SRE-2

alice (oncall): ack - I'm on it. seeing initial 5xx spike at 18:03 UTC. Starting triage.

alice (oncall): quick checks: `curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=us-east-1` -> `503` from most targets.

alice (oncall): `kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=us-east-1-az1 -o wide` shows ~30% pods OOMKilled and rest `CrashLoopBackOff` on inferencer containers. Node GPU utilization reported at ~98% on the affected pool.

ben (runtime): I'm seeing huge KV-cache miss storms in the logs — spikes in prefix mismatches. Queue depth for seq_len 2048 requests jumped x6. This matches the OOMs (memory blowouts).

carol (platform): Checking autoscaling: autoscaler attempted scale but hit soft quota for GPU v100 in us-east-1:az1. Command: `infra-tool scale pool inference-us-east-1-az1 --replicas 30` -> `QuotaExceeded: v100-cores-limit`.

alice (oncall): ETA to increase quota from cloud team is unknown. We'll need failover plan. Notifying support and triggering fallback routing to us-east-1:az2 then us-west-2 if needed.

support-bot: Notifying customers per policy. Draft status: "We are experiencing elevated error rates in us-east-1:az1, traffic may be routed to other zones. Engineers are investigating." Will post status page update in 10m.

dave (oncall-2): @alice if az2 capacity is healthy we should start a controlled traffic shift ~10-20% first. How fast can routing change propagate?

alice (oncall): We can do weighted routing via control plane. Plan: 1) set fallback to az2 at 20% 2) monitor 5xx and p50 latency for 5m 3) increment to 100% if stable. Running command now: `redwoodctl route update --region us-east-1 --from-az az1 --to-az az2 --weight 20 --reason "auto-fallback P0"`

alice (oncall): command output: `OK - routing policy updated (20% to az2). Change ID: ch-1800123456-1`

pagerduty: Escalation -> second tier notified (ben). Please acknowledge.

ben (runtime): ack. Spinning up warm instances in az2 (quantized variants) and warming KV cache with sample prefixes. Command: `infra-tool create pool inference-us-east-1-az2 --gpu=v100 --replicas=10 --image=runtime-1.12-q8`

carol (platform): infra-tool: request accepted, creating 10 replicas. Pod logs show `image pull` then `runtime init` in progress.

alice (oncall): traffic metrics after 5m: 5xx dropped ~35% overall, p50 latency normalized for routed requests. Continuing to increase to 60%.

alice (oncall): `redwoodctl route update --region us-east-1 --from-az az1 --to-az az2 --weight 60 --change-id ch-1800123456-2` -> `OK`

support-bot: Support note: Customers A123, B-Cloud, and internal partner sandbox saw >50% errors. Communicated Escalation + mitigation.

ben (runtime): Canary tests: `curl -H "x-canary: true" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=us-east-1` -> responses successful from az2 nodes, token streaming working, KV-cache hit rate improving.

dave (oncall-2): monitoring dashboards: cluster error rate trending down to baseline. Good to run extra health checks for 10m then start recovery steps.

alice (oncall): I'm going to handoff to ben for ongoing RCA and remediation. My next shift ends in 25m and dave is on deck for final confirmation. Handoff note: `alice -> ben` at 18:40 UTC.

ben (runtime): ack handoff. Next steps: collect core dumps, analyze OOM patterns, evaluate memory guardrails, and prepare tuned quantized builds to reduce memory footprint. Starting data capture: `log-collector run --since 30m --filter "pod:inference,az:az1" --out s3://ops-archives/incidents/1800123456/`

pagerduty: Incident status -> Acknowledged and mitigated. Continuing monitoring. If errors spike again, Pager will auto-escalate to Eng-Exec after 15m.

carol (platform): Opening internal ticket to request quota increase for az1 to avoid future soft-failover: TICKET-PLAT-1800.

support-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1800123456 - message: Investigating elevated error rates in us-east-1:az1; traffic being routed to az2 to mitigate customer impact.

alice (oncall): final metrics at 18:58 UTC: 5xx rate back down to baseline for most customers, p50 restored. Marking primary impact mitigated. Leaving incident open for RCA.

ben (runtime): root-cause provisional: KV-cache miss storm + memory leak in pretokenizer plugin causing pod OOMs under bursty long-sequence load. Will follow up with PR and canary roll.

dave (oncall-2): thanks all. I'll keep watch for next 60m. If stable, we'll close the incident and document postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident P-1800123456 status -> mitigated (traffic shifted, autoscale blocked by quota). Follow-up: RCA + quota ticket TICKET-PLAT-1800.

pagerduty: Closing notification suppressed until postmortem link provided.

alice (oncall): handing off final notes to #postmortems and assigning PM for customer comms. :thumbsup:
